title: Serving larger-than-memory MoE models
summary: Synthetic fixture for the 4090 blog layout. No measured results.
html:
Synthetic fixture content for layout testing. All timings and graph statements in this preview are invented.

1. The synthetic setup

A fictional local model reads a made-up incident report. The preview exercises the production blog and replay components without any service connection.

1.1 A bounded input

The fixture uses a fixed clock and a short deterministic stream.

2. What to inspect

Check the title, playback controls, article link, section index and day or night scheme at phone and desktop widths.
